
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/shenchuanchao/p/19744564" title="发布于 2026-03-20 16:21">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">字符串拼接用“+”还是 StringBuilder？别再凭感觉写了</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        
        字符串拼接这事，看起来小，但用错了地方，真能把程序拖垮。别再凭感觉了，记住三个关键词：少量用“+”、循环用Builder、集合用Join。写出性能好的代码，从选对拼接方式开始。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 data-pm-slice="0 0 []"><span><span>问题：拼接字符串，到底用哪个？</span></span></h2>
<p><span>先问个实在的问题：你在代码里怎么拼接字符串？</span></p>
<p><span>很多兄弟可能是这么写的：</span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;str =<span class="code-snippet__string">"Hello"+<span class="code-snippet__string">" "+<span class="code-snippet__string">"World"; &nbsp; &nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">//当然这里只是举个例子</span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><span>也有的会在循环里这么干：</span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;result =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__string">"";</span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">for&nbsp;(<span class="code-snippet__built_in">int&nbsp;i =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">0; i &lt;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">1000; i++)</span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>{</span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; result += i.ToString();&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// 循环拼接</span></span></code><code><span>}</span></code></pre>
<p><span>然后有一天，你听说了<code><span>StringBuilder</span></code><span>，据说拼接性能更好。于是你开始纠结：到底该用“+”还是<code><span>StringBuilder</span></code><span>？网上说法五花八门，有的说“+”慢成狗，有的说编译器会优化，根本不用操心。</span></span></span></p>
<p><span>今天咱们就把这事掰扯清楚，以后别再凭感觉写了。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>结论：看场景，别迷信</span></span></h2>
<p><span>一句话总结：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p>少量、固定次数的拼接，直接用“+”<span>，代码简洁，编译器还会帮你优化。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>大量、循环内的拼接，尤其是次数不确定时，务必用<code><span>StringBuilder</span></code><span>，否则性能可能崩盘。</span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>特殊场景（如拼接集合、格式化）考虑用<code><span>string.Concat</span></code><span>、<code><span>string.Join</span></code><span>或字符串插值<span>，它们底层已经做了优化。</span></span></span></span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<p><span>下面展开聊聊为什么。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>扩展：从内存到原理，一次讲透</span></span></h2>
<h3><span>1. 字符串的“不可变性”是罪魁祸首</span></h3>
<p><span>C#里的字符串是引用类型，而且是不可变的<span>。什么意思？就是你一旦创建了一个字符串，它就定型了，内容不能再改。当你试图“修改”它时，其实是创建了一个全新的字符串对象，原来的那个等着被垃圾回收。</span></span></p>
<p><span>比如：</span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="nginx"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__attribute">string&nbsp;s =<span class="code-snippet__string">"Hello";<span class="code-snippet__attribute">s&nbsp;= s +<span class="code-snippet__string">" World";</span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><span>第二行执行时，先在内存里创建一个新字符串&nbsp;<code><span>"Hello World"</span></code><span>，然后把<code><span>s</span></code><span>指向它，原来的&nbsp;<code><span>"Hello"</span></code><span>&nbsp;就成了没人要的孤儿，等着GC来收。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>这种设计有好处（线程安全、哈希缓存等），但拼接时就成了性能杀手。</span></p>
<h3><span>2. “+”拼接的真相：分情况讨论</span></h3>
<h4><span>情况A：编译期就能确定的拼接</span></h4>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;str =<span class="code-snippet__string">"Hello"+<span class="code-snippet__string">" "+<span class="code-snippet__string">"World";</span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><span>这种代码在编译时，编译器直接把它优化成了&nbsp;<code><span>"Hello World"</span></code><span>，生成的IL里只有一个字符串。所以运行时没有任何拼接开销，放心用。</span></span></p>
<h4><span>情况B：拼接中包含变量</span></h4>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;name =<span class="code-snippet__string">"刚子";</span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;msg =<span class="code-snippet__string">"Hello, "+ name +<span class="code-snippet__string">"!";</span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><span>这种编译器会把它转成<code><span>string.Concat</span></code><span>调用，比如：</span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;msg =<span class="code-snippet__built_in">string.Concat(<span class="code-snippet__string">"Hello, ", name,<span class="code-snippet__string">"!");</span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><code><span>string.Concat</span></code><span>内部会根据参数数量，一次性计算出最终字符串长度，然后分配内存，把各部分拷贝进去。一次拼接，一次分配<span>，效率其实不错。所以这种少量“+”拼接，完全没问题。</span></span></p>
<h4><span>情况C：循环内反复拼接</span></h4>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;result =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__string">"";</span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">for&nbsp;(<span class="code-snippet__built_in">int&nbsp;i =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">0; i &lt;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">10000; i++)</span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>{</span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; result += i.ToString();</span></code><code><span>}</span></code></pre>
<p><span>这里每循环一次，都会产生一个新的字符串，而且一次比一次大。比如：</span></p>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>第1次：长度1，分配1次</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>第2次：长度2，新分配，拷贝之前的结果和新的字符</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>第3次：长度3，再分配，拷贝……<span><br><span>这样总共分配了10000次字符串，拷贝的总字符数大约是1+2+...+10000 ≈ 5000万次！时间复杂度O(n²)<span>，数据量大时直接卡死。</span></span></span></span></p>


</li>


</ul>
<h3><span>3. StringBuilder 为什么快？</span></h3>
<p><code><span>StringBuilder</span></code><span>内部维护了一个可变的字符数组<span>（char[]）。当你 Append 时，它会直接往数组里写，空间不够了就自动扩容（通常是翻倍）。所有追加操作都在同一个数组里进行，只有最后调用<code><span>ToString()</span></code><span>时才真正创建一次字符串。</span></span></span></p>
<p><span>所以上面的循环用<code><span>StringBuilder</span></code><span>改写：</span></span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="java"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__type">StringBuilder&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__variable">sb&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__operator">=&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__keyword">new&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__title">StringBuilder();</span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__keyword">for&nbsp;(<span class="code-snippet__type">int&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__variable">i&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__operator">=&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">0; i &lt;&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__number">10000; i++)</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code><code><span>{</span></code><code><span>&nbsp; &nbsp; sb.Append(i.ToString());</span></code><code><span>}</span></code><code><span><span class="code-snippet__type">string&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__variable">result&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__operator">=&nbsp;sb.ToString();</span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p><span>扩容次数：大约 log₂(10000) ≈ 14次（假设初始容量16）</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><span>字符拷贝总量：约10000次，远小于“+”的5000万次</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>时间复杂度O(n)<span>，性能天壤之别。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>4. 来点实测数据</span></h3>
<p><span>我写了个简单测试（环境：.NET 6, Release模式，各执行10万次拼接）：</span></p>
<table>
<tbody>
<tr>
<td data-colwidth="143"><span>方式</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="143"><span>10次拼接</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="143"><span>1000次拼接</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="143"><span>10万次拼接</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-colwidth="143"><span>+（循环内）</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="143"><span>&lt;1ms</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="143"><span>15ms</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="143"><span>爆炸（几秒）</span></td>
</tr>
<tr>
<td data-colwidth="143"><span>StringBuilder</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="143"><span>&lt;1ms</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="143"><span>&lt;1ms</span></td>
<td data-colwidth="143"><span>8ms</span></td>
</tr>
</tbody>
</table>
<p><span>注意，“+”在小数量时差距不大，但一旦数量上去，直接崩盘。</span></p>
<h3><span>5. 其他拼接方式，也得拎清楚</span></h3>
<h4><span>string.Concat</span></h4>
<p><span>前面说了，编译器会把多个“+”优化成Concat。如果自己手动拼接一组已知的对象，用Concat比循环“+”强。</span></p>
<h4><span>string.Join</span></h4>
<p><span>拼接集合时最强：</span></p>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;csv =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__built_in">string.Join(<span class="code-snippet__string">",", numbers);&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__comment">// numbers是List&lt;int&gt;</span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><span>内部也是用StringBuilder实现的，比自己手写循环高效。</span></p>
<h4><span>字符串插值（$"..."）</span></h4>
<pre class="code-snippet__js" data-lang="cs"><code><span><span class="code-snippet__built_in">string&nbsp;msg =&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__string">$"Hello,&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__string"><span class="code-snippet__subst">{name}<span class="code-snippet__string">! You are&nbsp;<span class="code-snippet__string"><span class="code-snippet__subst">{age}<span class="code-snippet__string">&nbsp;years old.";</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></code></pre>
<p><span>编译后也是<code><span>string.Format</span></code><span>（或者在某些情况下转成Concat）。它简洁明了，适合格式化场景，但如果插值数量很多且频繁调用，注意<code><span>string.Format</span></code><span>内部也有开销（解析格式字符串、参数装箱等）。不过日常用没问题。</span></span></span></p>
<h3><span>6. 最佳实践总结</span></h3>
<ul class="list-paddingleft-1">
<li>
<p>原则1：能用一句话写完的拼接，直接用“+”<span>（编译器会优化）。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>原则2：循环内拼接，尤其次数不确定时，无脑用StringBuilder<span>。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>原则3：拼接集合用string.Join<span>。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>原则4：格式化用字符串插值或string.Format，但避免在热点代码中频繁使用带复杂格式的插值<span>。</span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>原则5：如果提前能预估最终长度，给StringBuilder预设容量（new StringBuilder(预期长度)），减少扩容<span>。</span></p>
</li>
</ul>
<h3><span>7. 面试官追问：StringBuilder就一定比“+”快吗？</span></h3>
<p><span>不一定。如果只是两三个字符串拼接，用“+”编译成Concat，可能比创建StringBuilder对象开销还小。毕竟new对象也有成本。所以“少量固定次数”时，“+”更优。</span></p>
<p><span>另外，如果你用的是.NET Core 2.1+，<code><span>string.Create</span></code><span>方法允许你直接操作字符数组，实现最高效的拼接，但那是高阶玩法，日常用不上。</span></span></p>
<h2><span><span>总结</span></span></h2>
<p><span>字符串拼接这事，看起来小，但用错了地方，真能把程序拖垮。别再凭感觉了，记住三个关键词：少量用“+”、循环用Builder、集合用Join<span>。写出性能好的代码，从选对拼接方式开始。</span></span></p>
